origin:
CLRT by Almeras emerged from the vibrant, albeit modestly funded, French club racing scene in the early 2000s. Founded by childhood friends Christian Landreau, a local Porsche enthusiast, and brothers Lionel and Remi Almeras, experienced mechanics with a passion for motorsport, the team initially focused on regional Porsche Carrera Cup events. Their early days were characterized by long nights in a small garage, meticulously preparing a second-hand 911 with limited resources. A pivotal moment came in 2008 when, against all odds, they secured a podium finish at a national-level race, attracting the attention of a few local sponsors and validating their commitment to the sport.

Driven by this initial success, CLRT by Almeras gradually expanded their operations, investing in better equipment and attracting talented young drivers eager to prove themselves. While they never aimed to compete with the factory-backed teams, their consistent performances and dedication to nurturing local talent earned them a respected position within the French racing community. Their focus remained on delivering competitive results within a reasonable budget, making them a popular choice for drivers looking to gain experience and exposure.
philosophy: CLRT by Almeras embraces a philosophy rooted in hard work, meticulous preparation, and a commitment to developing talent. They believe in extracting maximum performance from limited resources, focusing on fundamental car setup and driver development rather than chasing expensive upgrades. Their team culture is one of camaraderie and shared passion, fostering a supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to contribute and learn.
achievements: 2008: Podium finish at the French National Porsche Carrera Cup race
Multiple regional Porsche Carrera Cup victories
Consistent top-10 finishes in national-level GT series
Development of several young drivers who progressed to higher tiers of motorsport

teamPrincipal.name: Christian Landreau
teamPrincipal.background: Christian Landreau, a lifelong motorsport enthusiast and successful local businessman, provides the strategic vision and financial stability for CLRT by Almeras. He is known for his calm demeanor and ability to motivate his team, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment.

keyFigures.name: Lionel Almeras
keyFigures.description: Lionel Almeras is the technical mastermind behind CLRT by Almeras, possessing an encyclopedic knowledge of Porsche race cars. He is renowned for his ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues, often finding innovative solutions with limited resources.

keyFigures.name: Remi Almeras
keyFigures.description: Remi Almeras is responsible for the day-to-day operation of the garage, ensuring that the cars are meticulously prepared and maintained. His attention to detail and unwavering work ethic are crucial to the team's success.

headquarters: CLRT by Almeras operates from a small but well-equipped workshop located in a rural area near Montpellier, France. Their facilities are basic but functional, featuring a few car bays, a small engine room, and a modest office space.
fanBase: CLRT by Almeras enjoys a loyal following among local motorsport enthusiasts who appreciate their underdog spirit and commitment to developing French talent. Their fans are known for their enthusiastic support at regional races, often sporting team merchandise and cheering on their drivers.
